perspectives.summary: Miners must account for emissions from their products

representative_posts.author: raymondwilton.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Now the High Court has found that under NSW planning law, miners must also account for “scope three” emissions – the pollution created when the coal is burnt by their overseas customers – and decision-makers have to consider whether measures are needed to mitigate these emissions.

representative_posts.author: raymondwilton.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Decision by High Court, NSW coalmines must account for the emissions caused by the product when burnt overseas is “a game-changer” for coal production across the country, says Professor Jacqueline Peel, an international climate law expert with the Uni of Melbourne.

representative_posts.author: raymondwilton.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Ruling is far more narrow. The court found under NSW planning law, miners have to account for the climate damage done by their pollution. In the past, this has been interpreted to focus “scope one” emissions – that is, pollution created in NSW in the process of digging the stuff up.

representative_posts.text: Want to know what’s pathetic? People who criticize you and shit on you for expressing your thoughts or vent your frustrations making these works. I don’t care if it’s freedom of speech, that doesn’t stop folks from being an asshole.

representative_posts.author: snorthover.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Yeah. There's an element of "we all know what they mean", but if this kind of reaction is happening, the messaging really is shithouse.

representative_posts.author: evie-unit09.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: y'know a lot of us find that term insulting these days

representative_posts.author: 10-5.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Preferable to whom, exactly? …People who get upset over benign statements? I do not think that is a group worth taking seriously, from either direction.

representative_posts.author: ludwigsrifle.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: lets all learn to privately dm someone and say hey you hurt my feelings! its just really like. this situation is being blown up only because you are blowing it up! trying to encourage people to attack someone who hasn't even mentioned you by name is more bullying than anything else here?

perspectives.title: Bad

representative_posts.author: stevepeers.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Yeah, the usual rationale of "no reporting until charge" doesn't apply any more here

representative_posts.author: dawookie.bsky.social
representative_posts.text:
Punishment after the fact is nonsensical.

Fear, anger, anxiety DRIVE violence because those emotions are the subconscious mind TRYING to kill an ego that's been TRAINED to blame EXTERNAL reality for those "bad" feelings.

Smash your ego doors, kids.

There's WISDOM on the other side.
💲 >💚 = 🔥🌎

representative_posts.author: todoscojones.bsky.social
representative_posts.text:
Compliance is never enough.

They're going to beat up on you regardless.

I don't see this leading to better outcomes.

representative_posts.author: spiritcells.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: The world is unjust for this

representative_posts.author: armanwalker.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: There is no room for accommodating bad behavior.

representative_posts.author: pman57.bsky.social
